title: Fuel Access Split Along Regional Supply Lines
subtitle: Refinery regions recovered first while delivery-dependent regions remained rationed or dry.

data.label: Omsk region
data.detail: Purchase limits were removed in a major refinery region.

data.label: Volgograd region
data.detail: Limits returned after a renewed refinery disruption.

data.label: Astrakhan region
data.detail: Many filling stations operated only within short daily windows.

data.label: Novosibirsk region
data.detail: More than half of independent stations had no fuel.

data.label: Zabaykalsky krai
data.detail: Weekly deliveries covered only a fraction of regional demand.

data.label: Krasnodar krai
data.detail: Farmers received half the fuel required for seasonal work.

metadata.keyFinding: Regional fuel access diverged according to refinery proximity and delivery dependence.
